Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for orderpicker for the Bleckmann Ghent. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

• Departure at 5u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges, and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

 

!! Please note: you do NOT qualify if you're not already living in Belgium (in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges) and don't have legal permission to work in the country !!

jobs.occupation: Huxley Associates Belgium - PHP / JavaScript Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to join a long-term project focused on the development, maintenance, and modernization of a large-scale business-critical application ecosystem. The platform handles high volumes of sensitive data, integrates with multiple external systems, and operates in a highly available production environment.
Key responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications across the full technology stack.

• Develop and integrate REST APIs.

• Maintain and evolve complex legacy applications while ensuring stability and service continuity.

• Contribute to the migration from legacy technologies (PHP 5.6/7.4, CodeIgniter, AngularJS, JQuery) towards a modern stack based on PHP 8.2+, Laravel, and Vue.js.

• Improve application architecture, code quality, security, and maintainability.

• Participate in technical analysis, troubleshooting, code reviews, testing, and documentation.

• Collaborate closely with developers, analysts, UX/UI specialists, and project stakeholders within an Agile environment.

Additional information

• Professional English required.

• Long-term assignment with renewable contracts.

• Up to 3 days of remote work per week.

• Occasional on-site visits to operational environments and end users.

• Opportunity to work on applications with direct business impact and visibility.

• Strong experience with PHP and modern JavaScript.

• Solid knowledge of a modern PHP framework (Laravel preferred, Symfony also welcomed).

• Experience with a modern frontend framework (Vue.js is a plus).

• Comfortable working across both backend and frontend development.

• Strong understanding of SQL, REST APIs, GIT, and software development best practices.

• Proven experience maintaining and modernizing legacy applications in production environments.

• Ability to identify and remediate security issues in existing codebases.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Technical environment:

• Current stack: PHP 5.6/7.4, CodeIgniter, Smarty, AngularJS, JQuery

• Target stack: PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12+, Vue 3, JavaScript

• Database: PostgreSQL

• Version Control: GIT / GitLab

• Containers: Docker / Podman

• Operating Systems: Linux / Red Hat Enterprise Linux

• CI/CD: Modern CI/CD practices and tools

Nice to have:

• Experience with Laravel and/or Vue.js.

• Background in application modernization and legacy migration projects.

• Knowledge of application security best practices.

• Experience working on high-availability or mission-critical systems.

• Exposure to Symfony, React, Angular, or similar technologies.

The offer

• You run steering committees and governance forums, and keep actions, risks, decisions and escalations firmly on track.
• Your management presentations and decision proposals shape where the program goes next.
• KPIs, forecasts and portfolio reporting come together with you, giving management one clear and reliable view of performance, trends and risks.
• Deep-dive analyses of processes, tools and ways of working, especially at Fiberklaar, reveal where things can be simpler, smarter and more automated.
• Turning those insights into reality is where you make the difference: you define better processes, tooling improvements and future operating models, and you help bring them to life.
• As the trusted link between operations and management, you align partners around shared goals and help a fast-growing fibre organisation become more efficient, scalable and industrialised.

Desired profile

• Experience in program management and/or business transformation
• A proven track record in process analysis and process improvement
• Experience with KPI reporting, performance tracking and governance
• Experience in telecom, network deployment, construction or fibre rollout is an asset
💡 Your skills

• You quickly find your way in complex operational environments and turn findings into concrete improvements.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills help you get to the root of issues.
• You build trust with stakeholders at every level and communicate with ease.
• You work comfortably in Dutch, French and English.
🌟 Who are you?

• A structured organiser with a hands-on, results-oriented mindset
• Someone who brings order and keeps moving things forward
• Passionate about operational excellence, digitalisation and automation

We are currently looking for an experienced Senior .NET Architect to lead the architecture, modernization, and technical governance of a portfolio of business-critical enterprise applications.

This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who enjoys shaping architecture strategy, mentoring development teams, and driving large-scale modernization initiatives using modern Microsoft technologies.
Key responsibilities

• Lead the architecture of multiple application domains and enterprise solutions

• Define target-state architecture and modernization roadmaps

• Guide development teams on architecture decisions and complex technical challenges

• Lead migrations from legacy .NET Framework applications to modern .NET platforms

• Drive cloud-native and containerization initiatives

• Architect scalable MicroServices and distributed systems solutions

• Provide architectural guidance for Blazor applications

• Mentor and coach Full Stack .NET development teams

• Facilitate architecture reviews, design workshops, and technical governance activities

• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders

Nice to have

• Kubernetes (K8s)

• Cloud-Native Architecture

• Containerization Strategies

• Dapr

• NServiceBus

• Hangfire

• Distributed Systems Architecture

• Experience within Energy, Utilities, or Infrastructure sectors

What we're looking for

You are a strategic yet hands-on architect with a passion for building scalable, maintainable, and modern software solutions. You can influence technical direction, mentor engineering teams, and successfully drive modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

📩 Interested? Feel free to reach out or share your updated CV for a confidential discussion.

• Minimum 4 years of experience as a .NET Architect

• Strong expertise in:

• 

• C#

• .NET (Modern .NET & Legacy .NET Framework)

• Blazor

• SQL Server

• MongoDB

• RabbitMQ

• strong knowledge of

• Clean Architecture

• Software Architecture Design

• Technical Leadership

• experience with

• MicroServices Architecture

• Enterprise Application Modernization

• Leading Development Teams

• Technical Governance

• Cross-Team Technical Delivery

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Professional English skills

• Dutch or French language proficiency

The offer

• Join one of Belgium’s largest fibre rollouts as the technical and operational reference point for MDU (multi-dwelling unit) files within the Build & Deployment team.
• Each MDU file assigned to you is your responsibility: you follow its technical progress through every deployment step, including Delay orders, preventive tickets and POB (Proof of Build) deliveries.
• Reliable information is your starting point: you check the consistency of plans and technical data and challenge them when they don’t match reality.
• Anomalies, risks and blockers don’t stay hidden for long: you analyse their root causes, define resolution actions and escalate what needs a decision or extra expertise.
• SSV and TSA teams can count on your technical support, from preparing field interventions to analysing feedback and following corrective actions through to closure.
• In the field and behind the screen, you connect what happens on site with engineering, design and the Build team, and you feed verified field data to the Data Analyst Build.
• Build management relies on your clear reporting on file status, key risks and open actions, which gives them the visibility they need to de-risk MDU activities.

Desired profile

• A technical background that lets you understand and analyse issues in the field
• The following are an asset:
• experience in telecommunications, FTTH, infrastructure deployment or a similar environment
• knowledge of the FTTH and MDU environment
• knowledge of SSV and TSA activities
💡 Your skills

• You read and interpret technical plans and documents with ease.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills help you get to the root of an issue, and you are comfortable working with data.
• You work fluently with office and reporting tools.
• You communicate clearly with both technical and operational stakeholders.
• You speak French fluently and have a professional level of English. 
🌟 Who are you?

• Just as comfortable with data and documentation as you are with field teams
• Rigorous, organised and autonomous in your follow-up
• Someone who takes ownership of an issue, from its identification through to its resolution or escalation

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English, spoken and written.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment?

We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end contract and order management process by:

• Managing business contracts, including approval workflows and electronic signatures.
• Preparing and processing quotations while helping to standardize and optimize existing processes.
• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency, and accuracy, and ensuring timely processing and communication.
• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.
• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium-sized to large organization or a complex business environment.
• Initial experience in contract management, sales administration/support, or a paralegal role.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a focus on quality and accuracy.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.
• Comfortable managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.
• Tech-savvy, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Office, MS Dynamics CRM, and OneDrive.
• Fluent in English

For a banking customer in Brussels, we are searching for a freelance SQL DBA for a senior mission.

jobs.occupation: Customer Care Specialist - Banking Sector | Brussels
jobs.description:
As a Customer Care in Brussels, you will handle customer enquiries within the Financial Services sector and help provide clear, timely responses. Your work will support a consistent customer experience during a temporary assignment

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Financial Services industry in Brussels.

Description

As a Customer Care your responsibilities are:

• Respond to customer enquiries through the available service channels.
• Provide clear and accurate information to help customers resolve their requests.
• Record customer interactions and relevant details in the appropriate systems.
• Follow up on open enquiries to support timely resolution.
• Handle customer requests in line with agreed service processes.
• Escalate complex enquiries to the relevant internal contact when needed.
• Maintain accurate and complete customer records.
• Contribute to a reliable Customer Service experience for customers in Brussels.

A successful Customer Care should have:

• Experience handling customer enquiries in a service-focused setting.
• Ability to communicate information clearly and accurately in Dutch and English.
• Comfort working with customer records and digital systems.
• Ability to organise and follow up on several customer requests.
• Careful attention to detail when recording customer information.
• Ability to follow established customer service processes.

As a truck driver you are responsible to deliver and collect goods to our customers. You make collections and deliveries in all parts of Benelux or European countries. You report to the dispatching team.

 

 

You have C or CE and ADR driving license (with valid code 95).

You have a least 2 years of experience in driving with semi-trailers and are familiar with highways within BENELUX and west EU countries.

You speak Dutch (Flemish), French or English fluently. Any other European language is a plus.

You have your own car.

Robert Half is currently looking for an Office & Management Assistant (m/f/x).

The company is located in Brussels and this is a full-time position within an architecture and consulting environment.

 

You will join a growing, close-knit organisation of approximately 25 independent professionals, mainly architects. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the organisation.

 

This is not a traditional secretarial position. The company is looking for a versatile, hands-on and proactive individual who can take ownership of the operational and administrative management of the office, ranging from financial administration and project follow-up to coordinating external service providers.

 

You will work closely with management, gradually taking over a number of operational and administrative responsibilities. As the organisation continues to grow, you will have the opportunity to expand your responsibilities and develop towards a fully-fledged Office Manager position.

 

The responsibilities of this position as Office & Management Assistant are:

• You ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the office and oversee the general management of its facilities and services.
• You coordinate external service providers, including cleaning services, suppliers and delivery companies.
• You handle the administrative follow-up of clients, suppliers and various operational requests.
• You manage invoicing, including through Peppol and other digital platforms, and ensure the follow-up of outstanding customer and supplier invoices (approximately 300 invoices per year).
• You monitor payments, expense claims and professional expenses.
• You maintain contact with the external accounting firm and provide support with accounting and tax-related processes.
• You contribute to the financial and budgetary follow-up of approximately 50 to 60 projects running simultaneously.
• You monitor registered working hours and hourly rates to ensure accurate project invoicing.
• You prepare Excel reports, financial overviews and various management dashboards.
• You manage and update administrative information relating to projects and independent professionals.
• You actively identify opportunities to optimise internal processes through IT tools, management software and the automation of administrative tasks.
• You contribute to structuring and improving internal administrative procedures as the organisation continues to grow.
• You provide direct operational and organisational support to management.

The required qualifications for this position as Office & Management Assistant are:

• You have a first relevant experience in an administrative position, Office Management or Management Assistance. Motivated recent graduates are also encouraged to apply.
• You hold a degree in Business Management, IT, Software, Administration or an equivalent field.
• You have an excellent command of Dutch, French and English, both spoken and written. English is the main working language within the office.
• You have a strong affinity with figures, accounting, invoicing and financial processes.
• You have a good knowledge of Excel and are comfortable working with IT tools and management software.
• You are particularly interested in new technologies, digitalisation and process optimisation.
• You are well organised, accurate and able to manage several projects and priorities simultaneously.
• You are proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented, with a strong sense of initiative.
• You enjoy working independently while being a genuine team player.
• You feel comfortable in a small, dynamic working environment where you can take ownership and have a direct impact on the organisation.
